profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a software engineer, I understand that technical skills are essential, but I also know that having strong soft skills is equally important. 

I enjoy working with others, collaborating and contributing to a positive team culture,

I truly believe that having a growth mindset and a willingness to learn and adapt is critical for success in the technology industry. I stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies, and I am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer working for clients in the US.
Clients: Clearcover
Tech Stack: React, Typescript, SASS, redux, redux-saga, react-hooks, JavaScript ES6+, react-forms

Provided support/add new features to the consumer platform and internal platform for policy agents.
Generated React function components. Pass state through components using React context. Manage component lifecycle with React hooks.
Document processes, rituals, and debugging findings in Confluence.
Enhance formik schemas for forms.
Create unit tests, with at least 70% code coverage. 
Update typescript interfaces, data mappings, and types for features integration.
Pull, build, and run Docker containers for on-site services. PDF generation given a template
Built GitHub actions for CI to ensure the code is passing tests and pushing S3 buckets properly

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer working for clients in the US.
Clients: Clearcover, R.J. O'Brien
Tech Stack: React, Typescript, SASS, redux, redux-saga, react-hooks, Javascript ES6+, react-forms

Developed from scratch for future markets using React v16.8
Created unit test with Jest and React Testing Library
Used formik for schema, validation, and creation of forms
integration with the backend, usage of axios and redux sagas, redux-toolkit
Collaborated closely with .NET backenders to be on track with Swagger documentation
tech stack: React, React Router, Typescript, Jest, React Testing Library

positions.title: Supervising Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Management human resources application. Focused on the payroll module.
Implemented authentication and authorization with oAuth, used google and facebook strategies.
Used jwt for getting grants for logged users. Implemented RBCA across the whole application.
Built react components from figma mock-ups, worked closely with the design team. Used Ant Design UI framework. 
Debugged, analyzed, fixed, re-tested several bugs.
Integrated RESTful API using redux-sagas and axios, minimized calls due to react parent re-renders 
Created reusable functional components with react v16.8
Maintained application, documented processes in Confluence
tech stack: react, react router, typescript, react testing library, jest, nodejs, swagger, github, github actions, ant design, sql server, azure, jwt

positions.title: Software Engineer .NET
positions.description:
Provided support/added features for logistics maritime transportation application.
Developed react class components, vanilla Javascript and connected to fingerprint time attendance 
Gathered information/news from various portals through RSS and merged all these news where the company was pinged in order to deliver specialized analytics to higher positions within the company.
Documented processes, debugged findings in Confluence
Discovered, analyzed, fixed, tested and documented bugs for application.
tech stack: react, react router, javascript, .net, ADO NET, Stored Procedures, SQL Server, Entity Framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer .NET
positions.description:
Educational industry. Maintained and developed an application for teachers' performance assessments for high-school level and bachelor's degree.
Analyzed and enhanced performance, minimized memory consumption in stored procedures. 
Deployed application using IIS server. Debugged application using SQL Server profiler
Assembled information from SQL Server databases and created several reports with given data using crystal reports. Displayed real-time assessments in the webpage dashboard.
Collaborated with stakeholders and documented processes in Confluence .
tech stack: .net, ADO NET, Stored Procedures, SQL Server, IIS. ASP, SQL Server Profiler

company.name: Instituto Latinoamericano de la Comunicación Educativa ILCE

positions.title: Software Engineer .NET
positions.description:
Ported over bank checks digitalization application.
Created an application for configuration for current scanned checks. Logged in the server
Pulled information from database, built encrypted images. Put them all together into zip and sent over to the end user encrypted. 
Utilized generated on-site certificates for encryption.
tech stack: .net, sql server, c#, entity framework, sql server

positions.title: Software Engineer .NET
positions.description:
Developed from scratch a Point of Sale, focused on payments with Payments Terminal.
Created, integrated, tested and deployed functionality for payments with credit cards
Unified various bank web services (SOA) for payments module.
Built and utilized Entity Framework for connection to SQLServer and application
Generated numerous easy-to-use screens with MVVM architectural pattern
tech stack: .net WPF, MVVM, ADO .NET, Entity Framework SQL Server. web services

positions.title: Software Engineer .NET
positions.description:
Developed, maintained, and upgraded components in VB.Net
Performed several stored procedures for data manipulation and returned reports used by end users
Generated various ASP pages with C# and JQuery that impacted directly the end user.
Tech Stack: visual basic, .net, crystal reports, jQuery.
